contributor to MP (1878-85), novelist, translator

She married, first (1861) at Holy Trinity, Brompton, Vincenzo Costanzo Mazini, and secondly, the Italian historian Pasquale Villari (1827-1917).

She published fiction both as Linda Mazini and as Linda Villari, and also translated works by Villari and others.
